ACCOUNTANTS ACT 1967
ACCOUNTANTS (AMENDMENT OF First SCHEDULE) ORDER 1988

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 14 (7) of the
Accountants Act 1967, the Minister, after seeking advice of the
Malaysian Institute of Accountants, makes the following order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Accountants (Amendment of
First Schedule) Order 1988 and shall be deemed to have come into
force on the 1st January 1988.

2. The First Schedule to the Accountants Act 1967 is amended
by substituting for the full-stop at the end of paragraph (e) in Part I
a semicolon and the word "or" and by adding the following new
paragraph thereafter:

"(f) the final examination of Universiti Utara Malaysia for
the Degree of Bachelor of Accounting (Honours) or, in
the national laiiguage, "peperiksaan akhir Universiti
Utara Malaysia untuk Ijazah Sarjanamuda Perakaunan
(Kepujian)'."

Made the 14th November 1988.
. (ANM (T) Sulit 26/69 Pt. 5/(22); PN. (PU?) 229.)

DAIM BIN ZAINUDDIN,
Minister of Finance
